title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap record and Microsoft Learn. Both API calls, the control paths and the consumption-based licensing are documented; the remaining gaps are appropriately limited to what Microsoft has not documented for the agent node.
